scope: Continuous relative production potential with station-calibrated weather-event and modeled-chilling constraints. Not globally validated reliable-yield probability.

freezeWeatherValidation.scope: Weather-event geographic holdout verification of the nine-quantile runtime approximation, not harvest reliability. Same matched accepted years for raw and calibrated predictions.
limits: Calibration model was chosen using these folds; external prospective validation is still needed.
Worst-freeze severity and exposure duration are not validated by these frequency scores.
The production index response and recovery multiplier remain explicit screening choices, not fitted yield losses.

chillingModelValidation.scope: Calibration of modeled daily-weather DMA requirement attainment from modeled CHELSA normal-year CU. Not observed flower/fruit or yield probability.
chillingModelValidation.crossValidation: Leave complete geographic regions out; all cultivar outcomes of a station stay together. Station/cultivar equal weighting. Selection using these folds is not an independent final test.

limitations: Orchard studies are sparse and previously visible to developers; geographic/study holdouts are compatibility checks, not representative global predictive validation.
No reliable annual harvest probability, tonnage, profitability, water-supply feasibility, soil drainage, pollination or disease-control outcome is inferred.
Monthly normals and estimated hourly temperatures cannot replace observed interannual flower induction. Warm/rare cultivars may fruit outside this screening model.
Freeze error distribution is calibrated at 49 stations in eight regions. Prodromos is an additional development station excluded from those metrics.
Native chilling uses a winter-temperature anomaly applied to overview monthly normals; source annual freezes remain regional.
Freeze injury response and recovery weighting are explicit agronomic screen choices, not a fit to observed crop-loss fractions.
